_readme: Your details for this edition. tools/build-edition.mjs fills them into the README, LICENSE and landing page, and gives the app the licensing settings. Replace every YOUR-… value before you sell; the build lists any you missed. Only put PUBLIC values here (no API keys or secrets): it ships inside the app.
refundPolicy: Not happy? Email within 14 days for a full refund.
founderNote: Soma started as the planner I built to get through my own PhD: one calm screen, one task at a time, and a way to see progress on work that takes years. Now it's yours too.
